title: HIJrax Textures
description: The Best Textures ever by enhancing the vanilla tools and armor
body:
Slight modifications to the vanilla tools, weapons, and more miscellaneous additions.

Themed around a smiley face and gives all netherite weapons and armors a red hue. Changes hoes to be like scythes, makes swords smaller, and adds points to the axes.

Other smaller changes:
- More visible ancient debris
- New effects
- Smaller swords and spears when held
